clips.text_zh: 沙特東西輸油管俾人打中，火燭幾個位，AI 估要 6 至 12 個月先修得好。即係 Hormuz 峽都唔使點守。但油價今日反而跌咗，反常到爆。靠 CFD 揸緊 oil，頭都痕。
clips.text_en_b1: Big news: oil may hit $150 soon. The Saudi east-west pipeline got hit, so Saudi oil can no longer go around the Strait of Hormuz. This is the only pipeline from the Persian Gulf to the Red Sea. Satellite pictures show fires in multiple places. AI repair estimates say 6 to 12 months. Saudi Arabia has 10% of global oil production.
clips.source_hint: /biz/ thread about Saudi pipeline damage and oil supply

signal.rationale: OP sees Middle East supply shock and irony of oil dumping — classic inflation/geopolitical hedge setup favors gold long

clips.text_en_b2: Saudi Arabia's east-west pipeline has been struck, with satellite imagery confirming multiple fires along the route. Although repairs could reportedly take anywhere from six to twelve months, crude actually dumped in today's session, which frankly defies logic. Given that the Kingdom accounts for roughly ten percent of global supply, the Strait of Hormuz suddenly becomes far less of a chokepoint.
clips.text_en_c1: Saudi Arabia's east-west pipeline has been struck, with satellite imagery confirming multiple fires along its length. This single artery, which ordinarily bypasses the Strait of Hormuz entirely, accounts for the Gulf's only viable export route to the Red Sea, and AI-assisted damage assessments suggest repairs could take anywhere from six to twelve months. Given that the kingdom produces roughly ten percent of global oil, one would naturally expect prices to spike. Paradoxically, crude actually dumped during the session, a move that defies conventional logic.
clips.text_en_c2: The East-West pipeline has reportedly been struck at several points, with conflagrations visible across multiple segments in freshly circulated satellite imagery. AI-driven damage assessments, insofar as such probabilistic models can be trusted, project a remediation window of anywhere between six and twelve months. Given that this conduit constitutes the sole artery diverting Saudi crude away from the chokepoint at Hormuz, the strategic calculus in the Gulf has been quietly redrawn. Saudi Arabia still commands roughly a tenth of global production, yet despite the geopolitical magnitude of the disruption, front-month Brent sold off sharply in today's session, a paradoxical reaction that flummoxed even seasoned desks. Those of us long oil via contracts for difference are nursing the consequences. One suspects the algos are pricing diplomatic de-escalation rather than physical scarcity.

clips.text_zh: 又話 DOGE 三日內衝上太空，叫人入少少再放，唔好變 SNL 2.0。今次真係假反彈定真起飛？prop firm 啲錢都唔夠燒。
clips.text_en_b1: Doge goes to space in 3 days and you are not buying. If this thing explodes it will still move up, so why not ape a bit, then sell before it becomes SNL 2.0. Or maybe it just starts the hype cycle again. Either way, easy scalp setup on the CFD desk.
clips.source_hint: /biz/ Doge hype thread about an upcoming catalyst

signal.rationale: OP proposes a small long scalp into a hype catalyst, with planned sell to avoid SNL-style dump

clips.text_en_b2: Apparently DOGE is blasting off within three days, and the consensus seems to be: ape a small position, then dump before it inevitably turns into another SNL-style rug pull. While some argue this could merely reignite the broader hype cycle, others insist it is a classic fakeout designed to fleece latecomers. Either way, prop firm capital is getting shredded in the meantime, because traders cannot resist chasing what looks like an easy scalp setup on the CFD desk.
clips.text_en_c1: Doge is purportedly heading to the stratosphere within seventy-two hours, and the prevailing wisdom suggests a measured position before any potential SNL-style collapse. If the token genuinely catches fire, even a modest allocation would yield disproportionate gains on the way up, provided one exits before the crowd rotates out. Should the rally prove illusory, the resulting bleed would likely mirror the 2021 SNL episode that wiped out leveraged longs. Either scenario presents a textbook scalp opportunity at the CFD desk, particularly given that prop firm capital is evaporating faster than anticipated. The asymmetry looks compelling, yet the timing window remains razor-thin.
clips.text_en_c2: The thesis circulating among retail cohorts is straightforward: DOGE purportedly has a three-day window before some catalyst, perhaps a platform integration or a celebrity cameo, propels it toward orbit. The asymmetry, proponents argue, remains compelling even if the upside is capped, since a measured entry with a tight invalidation still offers a respectable risk-adjusted scalp. Skeptics, however, counter that this resembles the SNL episode of 2021, when a parabolic advance collapsed into a brutal retracement once liquidity dried up. Whether one interprets the present setup as a genuine trend resumption or merely a reflexive bounce within a broader capitulation structure, the tactical conclusion for CFD operators is unaltered. Prop shops, already thinned by the preceding drawdowns, are unlikely to absorb another round of forced liquidations without visible strain.

clips.text_zh: 22 歲 dogecoin 贏錢即刻買 condo，兩年無做過嘢。27 歲返去做返工程仔，背住學貸同 card debt。feel like I am stuck。同我個 case 太似。考牌都未完，邊度有 230K。
clips.text_en_b1: Stuck with a condo. Back in 2021, when I was 22, I made random crypto money from dogecoin. I lived for two years with no job, perma vacation, dropped out of school, and bought a condo for $230K. Eventually the money ran out. I went back to school, graduated, and now make $100K, living in my condo.
clips.source_hint: /biz/ regret thread from a 27-year-old who cashed out crypto and bought a condo

signal.rationale: Personal-finance regret story, no actionable trade setup

clips.text_en_b2: Back in 2021, at twenty-two, I struck it lucky with dogecoin and bought a two-hundred-thirty-K condo outright. I spent two years living like a permanent tourist, dropped out of school, and burned through every last dollar. Eventually I crawled back, finished my engineering degree, and now pull in around a hundred grand while drowning in student loans and credit card debt.
clips.text_en_c1: At twenty-two, I stumbled into a windfall from speculative Dogecoin positions, and within months I had abandoned my engineering studies and sunk the proceeds into a two-bedroom condominium that cost roughly $230K. For two years I coasted through a kind of permanent holiday, convinced the gravy train had no terminus. When the capital inevitably dried up, I returned to university, eventually graduating into a $100K salary, which on paper should have felt like redemption. Instead, I find myself at twenty-seven trapped in what can only be described as a Sisyphean loop of earning and consuming, shackled to student loans and revolving credit card debt.
clips.text_en_c2: At twenty-two, flush with an improbable windfall from dogecoin, I purchased a condominium for $230,000 and proceeded to suspend all productive activity for two full years, a period characterised by perma-vacation, deferred tuition, and a creeping sense that the music would never stop. It did. By the time the capital evaporated, I had re-enrolled, eventually graduated, and secured a position paying a respectable $100,000, which I now inhabit within the very unit that once symbolised my escape. At twenty-seven, the arithmetic is unflattering: student obligations, revolving credit balances, and a salary consumed almost entirely by mortgage maintenance. The travail is not poverty, but something subtler, namely the paralysing awareness that one has already inhabited a stratum of life that one's current trajectory cannot indefinitely sustain.

clips.text_zh: 啲 AI 公司自己都認 model 撞牆啦，跟住又話「self-restraint」呃 VC 錢。咁我仲使唔使驚被 AI 取代？廢柴 engineering 路仲有冇得行。
clips.text_en_b1: They are now admitting AI models have plateaued. The labs are making up a story about self-restraint so they do not lose VC money. The real scaling laws hit a wall, but nobody on the cap table wants to admit it yet. Bullshit cycle continues, just slower now.
clips.source_hint: /g/ thread arguing AI labs are hiding plateau from VCs
clips.text_en_b2: The major labs are quietly conceding that their frontier models have hit a wall, although they are spinning a convenient narrative about deliberate self-restraint to keep VC money flowing in. The underlying scaling laws have essentially broken down, yet nobody sitting on those cap tables wants to break the bad news to their limited partners. So the bullshit cycle grinds on, albeit at a noticeably slower pace, while ordinary engineers wonder whether their careers are doomed or whether the AI apocalypse has been quietly postponed.
clips.text_en_c1: The frontier laboratories have quietly conceded that their latest models have hit a wall, though publicly they prefer the more palatable narrative of deliberate self-restraint, presumably to preserve their valuation discussions with venture capital allocators. The underlying scaling laws, which once promised exponential returns on compute expenditure, appear to have flattened, a development that anyone following the empirical benchmarks foresaw. Yet nobody holding a board seat is particularly incentivised to acknowledge that the well has run dry, since doing so would crater their next funding round overnight.
clips.text_en_c2: The leading laboratories have, with conspicuous reluctance, conceded that frontier models are exhibiting diminishing returns on additional compute, a phenomenon insiders have privately acknowledged for months. The official narrative now emphasises judicious self-restraint, ostensibly to forestall capabilities that might alarm regulators, though the subtext is transparent to anyone versed in the sector's incentive structures. The genuine scaling laws, those that once underwrote billion-dollar cap tables, have effectively plateaued, yet no major stakeholder is prepared to be the first to articulate the obvious. Capital allocation continues apace, talent is retained at extraordinary expense, and the press cycle churns out its accustomed superlatives. Whether this constitutes a temporary ceiling or a structural inflection, the implications for software engineers, who had begun quietly contemplating career pivots, remain decidedly ambiguous.

clips.text_zh: 英國 Skimpflation 又嚟，罐頭鯖魚頂住先。KFC 刀斬少年，加埋反移民自己出船堵。睇完好慶幸自己響香港做 slope survey，唔好去英國搞嘢。
clips.text_en_b1: Britain looks dystopian right now. Skimpflation warning as tinned mackerel alternative hits more supermarket shelves. A boy, 14, was among three teenagers stabbed in a KFC machete gang fight. Anti-immigration protesters say they will use their own boat to intercept migrants in the Channel. Three stories, one week, same country.
clips.text_en_b2: Britain is starting to look genuinely dystopian, because three grim stories landed in a single week. Supermarkets are quietly rolling out tinned mackerel as a budget substitute under what economists are calling the latest skimpflation wave. Meanwhile, a fourteen-year-old boy was hospitalised after a machete brawl broke out inside a KFC. To top it off, anti-immigration activists have vowed to deploy their own vessel to intercept migrant boats crossing the Channel.
clips.text_en_c1: Britain appears to be descending into something resembling a dystopian tableau, if the past week's headlines are any indication. Supermarket shelves are increasingly populated with tinned mackerel, a stopgap measure as skimpflation creeps across the grocery sector and quality erodes by stealth. Separately, a fourteen-year-old boy was hospitalised after being macheted during a gang altercation inside a KFC, a scene that would have seemed farcical a decade ago. Compounding matters, anti-immigration activists have vowed to deploy private vessels in the Channel to physically intercept migrant dinghies.
clips.text_en_c2: Britain appears, by any reasonable measure, to be undergoing a quiet unraveling across multiple vectors simultaneously. Supermarket shelves now routinely stock tinned mackerel as a cost-driven substitute for pricier proteins, a phenomenon dubbed skimpflation, which speaks volumes about the discretionary budget of the average household. Meanwhile, in a KFC outlet, three teenagers, one merely fourteen, were hospitalised following a machete altercation that would have been unthinkable a decade ago. Concurrently, anti-immigration activists have announced intentions to deploy private vessels in the Channel to physically intercept migrant crossings. Three vignettes, one calendar week, each emblematic of a polity grappling with inflation, youth violence, and contested sovereignty. From my vantage point conducting slope surveys in Hong Kong, the decision not to relocate westward feels vindicated.

clips.text_zh: 肥仔信問我幾時 cut 好。我由 83kg 切到 65kg，再 lean bulk 上返 80kg。bench 1 plate、squat 90kg、deadlift 120kg。睇落同零訓練嘅 80kg 唔同，但係咪夠？睇完條 thread 我又要去 gym。
clips.text_en_b1: How do I know when I have bulked enough to cut and escape skinnyfat. In May 2025 I was 83kg fat with almost no muscle. I cut hard until mid April 2026 down to 65kg skinnyfat, I could not even bench the 20kg bar. Then I lean bulked up to now, back to 80kg.
clips.source_hint: /fit/ bulk vs cut progress thread with concrete numbers

signal.rationale: Fitness progress post, not a trade

clips.text_en_b2: I started at eighty-three kilos of largely sedentary fat back in May 2025, then cut hard down to sixty-five by mid-April 2026, at which point I could barely bench the empty twenty-kilo bar. After that I ran a lean bulk back up to eighty kilos, and my numbers have climbed accordingly: three by eight at one plate on bench, three by six at ninety on squat, and three by eight at a hundred and twenty on deadlift.
clips.text_en_c1: A novice lifter asked the thread at what point one ought to commence a cut in order to escape the dreaded skinnyfat physique. My own trajectory provides a reasonably instructive case: back in May 2025 I tipped the scales at eighty-three kilograms with negligible muscle mass, prompting an aggressive deficit that bottomed out at sixty-five kilograms by mid-April 2026, at which point I could barely press the unloaded twenty-kilogram barbell. From that nadir I embarked on a measured lean bulk, and currently I sit at eighty kilograms, which on the mirror looks markedly different from my untrained 2025 self.
clips.text_en_c2: The perennial question confronting the formerly overweight novice is when, precisely, sufficient lean mass has accrued to justify a caloric deficit without sacrificing the muscle painstakingly accumulated. My own trajectory offers a case study. In May 2025, I tipped the scales at 83 kilograms with negligible muscular development, a body composition that conventional wisdom would classify as obese. I executed an aggressive cut through April 2026, emerging at 65 kilograms in a state textbook skinnyfat, so depleted that even the unloaded twenty-kilogram barbell posed a challenge. Subsequently, I commenced a measured lean bulk, restoring my weight to 80 kilograms while progressively loading compound movements: bench press at one plate for sets of eight, squats at ninety kilograms, and deadlifts at 120.

These predawn releases, dropped while the broader board is dormant, possess a particular charm that the daylight threads never quite replicate. clips.text_en_c2: The translation of 100 Kanojo chapter 255 has, as of this composition, been publicly available for slightly over an hour, a window that the dedicated scanlation community has learned through hard experience not to squander.
